neural-process-twin.canonical_title: Neural Process Twin (SciML / 2D Heat Conduction / PINNs)
neural-process-twin.domain: Scientific Machine Learning / Neural Operators / Surrogate Simulation
neural-process-twin.exact_technical_scope: Built a learned-simulation workflow in PyTorch using data from conventional numerical simulations to approximate 2D steady-state physical fields (temperature, velocity, concentration). Implemented model training and inference, compared predicted fields with numerical-solver outputs across changes in resolution and parameters, and evaluated physical consistency and surrogate generalization.
measured_results: Faster inference speedup compared to standard finite-difference solvers on 2D steady-state heat equation
Evaluated prediction error and physical consistency under parameter and resolution variations

llm-inference-engine.canonical_title: LLM Inference Intelligence Engine (Hardware Profiling & Roofline Diagnostics)
llm-inference-engine.domain: AI Systems / Performance Engineering / Inference Diagnostics
llm-inference-engine.evidence_source: Harshith_N_Research_CV_Summer2027.pdf (Page 1, AI Systems and Product Engineering)
llm-inference-engine.exact_technical_scope: Built an end-to-end tool for evaluating LLM inference configurations under different hardware and workload constraints, treating model size, serving configuration, and workload as coupled design choices. Structured evaluation around time to first token (TTFT), inter-token latency (TPOT/ITL), generated-token throughput, and peak memory across CPU and GPU configurations. Compared quantization, batch size, context length, and inference backends (ONNX Runtime, PyTorch). Implemented Roofline model diagnostics isolating compute bounds from memory-bandwidth bottlenecks.
measured_results: Empirical measurement of TTFT, TPOT, and memory across quantization, batch sizes, and context lengths
Roofline model diagnostics isolating memory-bandwidth saturation versus compute bounds
allowed_phrasing: measurement-driven LLM inference benchmarking tool
profiling TTFT, inter-token latency, throughput, and memory across batch sizes and quantization levels

empirical trade-off analysis across ONNX Runtime and PyTorch backends

thermo-cpp-solver.canonical_title: Peng-Robinson Real-Gas Cubic Equation of State Solver (C++17)
thermo-cpp-solver.domain: Computational Thermodynamics / Process Systems Engineering / C++ Systems
thermo-cpp-solver.exact_technical_scope: Developed modular C++17 software for real-gas pressure-volume-temperature (PVT) calculations using the Peng-Robinson (PR-1976) cubic equation of state. Solved cubic polynomials in compressibility factor Z, discarding unphysical roots (Z <= B). Evaluated analytical derivative (dP/dv)_T for thermodynamic mechanical stability classification. Computed enthalpy and entropy departure functions using ideal-gas property contributions and real-gas departure integrals, alongside pure-component fugacity calculations.
measured_results: Verified root classification (Z > B) for vapor and liquid states
Analytic derivative (dP/dv)_T evaluated for mechanical stability identification
Enthalpy, entropy departure functions and pure-component fugacity matching reference standards
allowed_phrasing: modular C++17 real-gas PVT calculations using Peng-Robinson cubic equation of state
analytical (dP/dv)_T derivatives for thermodynamic mechanical stability classification
enthalpy and entropy departure functions and pure-component fugacity calculations
prohibited_phrasing: multi-component chemical distillation column flash simulations

pinn-error-estimation.domain: Scientific Computing / Numerical Analysis / Applied Mathematics
pinn-error-estimation.exact_technical_scope: Audited a finite-difference error-estimation workflow for physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), tracing the norm formulation, baseline implementation, and experiment outputs. Ran a controlled grid-resolution study comparing estimated discrepancies with reference-solution errors on 1D Heat Equation benchmarks. Extended analysis to soft boundary constraints and pointwise defect propagation without analytical solutions.

Fine-grid empirical convergence order was approximately 2.01 in the tested setup
